title: Glute Bridge Fix for Taller Posture
style: Kids crayon drawing on white paper, playful and messy but beautiful, consistent, simple bright colors, plain clean white background, portrait 2:3, no text in images.
character: Same 19–20-year-old adult character in every slide: friendly, fully clothed in a coral tank top, navy athletic shorts, white socks, simple sneakers, short dark curly hair, warm medium skin tone, playful crayon texture.
voice: Upbeat, friendly, brisk delivery with energetic emphasis on the key fix.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.a: Portrait 2:3 kids crayon drawing on white paper, subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image empty, whole body visible, no text letters or numbers. Same adult character lying on their back on a simple mat, side view, head to the left and feet to the right. Shoulders, upper back, head, and both feet touch the floor; knees bent about ninety degrees; feet flat hip-width apart; arms resting on floor beside the body with palms down. At the top of a glute bridge, hips are lifted too high, lower back is clearly overarched, ribs flared upward, belly pushed up, pelvis tilted forward, neck slightly tense, showing the wrong form. Plain clean background, messy playful crayon lines.
exercises.b: Portrait 2:3 kids crayon drawing on white paper, subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image empty, whole body visible, no text letters or numbers. Same adult character, same side angle and framing, lying on their back on the same simple mat, head to the left and feet to the right. Shoulders, upper back, head, and both feet touch the floor; knees bent about ninety degrees; feet flat hip-width apart; arms resting on floor beside the body with palms down. At the top of a correct glute bridge, ribs are down, pelvis tucked slightly, glutes engaged, lower back neutral, body forms a clean straight diagonal line from shoulders through hips to knees. Plain clean background, messy playful crayon lines.

exercises.name: HIP FLEXOR LUNGE
exercises.a: Portrait 2:3 kids crayon drawing on white paper, subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image empty, whole body visible, no text letters or numbers. Same adult character in a half-kneeling lunge stretch, side view facing right. Left knee and left shin touch the floor behind the body; right foot is flat on the floor in front with right knee bent over the ankle; torso tall; hands placed on hips; pelvis tucked gently; back toes relaxed on the floor; shoulders down and relaxed. Correct starting position for a hip flexor lunge stretch, plain clean background, playful messy crayon style.
exercises.b: Portrait 2:3 kids crayon drawing on white paper, subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image empty, whole body visible, no text letters or numbers. Same adult character, same side angle and framing, in the other end of the hip flexor lunge stretch. Left knee and left shin still touch the floor behind; right foot stays flat in front with knee bent over ankle. Hips glide slightly forward while pelvis remains tucked, glute on the kneeling side squeezed; torso stays tall; both arms reach overhead with long relaxed fingers, making the pose clearly different from the hands-on-hips start. Plain clean background, playful messy crayon style.

result: Portrait 2:3 kids crayon drawing on white paper, subject centered with generous margins, top 18% of image empty, whole body visible, no text letters or numbers. Same adult character standing tall and relaxed, feet hip-width apart, knees soft, pelvis neutral, ribs stacked over hips, shoulders back and down, chin level, arms relaxed at sides, proud happy smile, looking confident with great posture. Plain clean white paper background, playful messy crayon style.

lines.hook: Most people crank bridges from the low back.
lines.ex1: Tuck your pelvis, squeeze glutes, and lift without rib flare.
lines.ex2: Then stretch hip flexors so your hips stack under you.
lines.takeaway: Better alignment helps you stand taller.
